newsitem.title: POLAND: BIG firm, fund take most of Viscoplast IPO.
newsitem.headline: BIG firm, fund take most of Viscoplast IPO.

text.p: A BIG SA subsidiary and National Investment Fund (NFI) No.11 have been allotted 580,000 shares in the 900,000-share initial public offering of Polish chemical firm Viscoplast SA, the firm said on Monday.

Viscoplast said Bel Leasing sp zoo and the fund had been allotted the lion's share of the 690,000-share large-investor tranche based on the issue's stipulation that the underwriters would be favoured in the event of an oversubscription.

BIG underwrote 605,000 shares, NFI 11 295,000. Last week the firm said investors subscribed for 1,909,513 shares in the large-investor tranche and for 1,992,132 shares in the 210,000-share small-investor tranche.
Monday's statement said investors bidding for the remaining 110,000 shares in the large-investor tranche had their bids reduced by 91.7 percent.
It said investors in the small-investor tranche had their bids were reduced by 89.4 percent.

Viscoplast, which seeks a listing on the Warsaw bourse's parallel market of smaller, less liquid stocks, offered the shares at 14 zlotys each from January 27 to February 5. (( -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700 ))
